this group is dedicated to discussion of RHadoop and related packages. You would be better served to  ask your question in a different forum. If it is RHadoop you are talking about, I would suggest help(mapreduce) and help(make.input.format). There is nothing like reading the manual to make you effective at writing programs with RHadoop.
